text.p: Grain and oilseed exports reported by USDA and private export sources.
BARLEY SALES - The Canadian Wheat Board sold 150,000 tonnes of feed barley to Saudi Arabia at US$145 a tonne FOB Vancouver, traders said. The CWB declined to comment.

- Saudi Arabia agreed to buy 700,000 tonnes of optional-origin barley from the world market at prices ranging from $163.50 to $173.50 per tonne c and f, European grain traders said. The deals still lacked official confirmation but should be finalised soon, the said. Offers must stay valid for two weeks
SOYBEAN SALE - The Kaohsiung division of Taiwan's Breakfast Soybean Procurement Association bought 54,000 tonnes of Brazilian soybeans from Louis Dreyfus Tuesday. Shipment was for July.

CORN AND BARLEY SALE - The Cyprus Grain Commission said it bought 18,000 tonnes of corn from Tradigrain S.A. of Geneva at $139.42 a tonne C and F and 25,000 tonnes of barley from Soufflet France at $163.50 a tonne C and F.

SOYMEAL TENDER - South Korean buyer group, Big Feed Mills, would invite tenders to buy 30,000 tonnes of soymeal on Wednesday, traders said. Arrival was for September 20 to the two South Korean ports of Kunsan and Ulsan. Shipment was slated for August 10-31 if sourced from India or for July 20-August 10 if from South America.

WHEAT TENDERS - Egypt said Tuesday it sought 50,000 tonnes of U.S., French or Australian wheat for July 1 to July 20 delivery. The deadline for bids was 0900 local/0600 GMT on Wednesday and the result would be announced that day.
WHEAT TENDERS - Results are awaited on Iraq's tender for 50,000 tonnes of U.S. hard red winter wheat for July shipment under a United Nations oil-for-food deal. Tender offers were due on May 20.
BARLEY TENDER - Results were awaited on Iran's tender to buy 100,000 tonnes of optional-origin feed barley for shipment in August.
RICE TENDERS - Syria's General Foreign Trade Organisation for Chemicals and Foostuffs seeks offers June 4 to buy 12,000 tonnes of white rice for July with confirmation on June 12.
RICE TENDERS - The state-run Rice Export Corporation of Pakistan invited bids by May 26 for the export of 5,000 tonnes of basmati Pak-7 rice containing seven percent broken.
- Jordan seeks 15,000 tonnes of medium grain camolina type rice on May 21 for June delivery

MARKET TALK - Malaysian corn importers were bracing for heavy losses on Tuesday as prices continued to fall in a market overloaded with corn, trader sources said. An arrival of 50,000 tonnes of corn in the last week added to an existing stockpile of around 100,000 tonnes to squeeze importers' margins further, they added.
